mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.0% signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a collapsing housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline by more than 5% from the prior month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing supply shock (INDPRO decline > 10% from peak), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate profitability and increased inflationary pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines >10% from 12-month high, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the year-over-year CPI inflation above 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A declining trend in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals ongoing labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of 60-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a consumer demand contraction (GDPC1 decline > 1% quarter-over-quarter), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 QoQ declines exceed 1.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a broad-based economic contraction that reduces corporate investment and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline by more than 5% from the prior month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
